description: In this .25 course, students build knowledge, skills, and habits to succeed. Students read Robin Wall Kimmerers The Serviceberry to explore questions of self, identity, purpose, meaning, and value. Topics include scarcity, abundance, gift, authenticity, reciprocity, resilience, purpose, and the common good. Students identify and deepen individual strengths related to these topics through course activities, experiences on and near campus, and sustained reflection. Students also contribute to something larger than themselves, as their insights, questions, and suggestions will help shape future courses that benefit the campus community. P/N only.
